title: UW Markdown Module Manifest
description: Declarative manifest for a UW Markdown module. Modules extend the standard 21 sections with asset-class-specific schemas, calculations, validations, view models, and agent layer prompts. Modules in v1 are declarative-only — formulas use a safe-expression language; no executable code. Mirrors the TypeScript ModuleManifest type in @uwmd/core/protocol.ts.

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version. Always '1' for protocol v1.

requires_protocol.description: Semver range against the UW Protocol version (e.g. '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0' or '^1'). Protocol 1.3.0 adds the numeric model in section VIII.5; a module whose calculations depend on a declared round_to being honoured should require '>=1.3.0'.

requires_format.description: Semver range against the .uw.md format version.

requires_tier.description: Minimum host tier required to load this module. A module with custom calculations requires at least tier-3-calc-host.

asset_classes.description: Asset classes this module is intended for. Omit to indicate the module is class-agnostic.

sections.description: Custom or extended section declarations. v1 cannot declare new asset_class values, but can extend existing standard sections with additional optional fields, or add module-namespaced sections.

schema.description: JSON Schema fragment for the section content. Validated by the calc host on load.

required.description: If true, the host treats this section as mandatory for the declared deal_stages.

calculations.description: Custom calculations contributed by this module. Each is a safe-expression formula evaluated by a Tier-3 calc host.

formula.description: Safe-expression string. Grammar: arithmetic, comparison, conditional, function call only. See UW_PROTOCOL_v1.md §VIII.1.

unit.description: Display unit (e.g. '%', '$', 'x'). Also selects the default round_to when round_to is omitted — see UW_PROTOCOL_v1.md §VIII.5.

round_to.description: Decimal places the reported value is quantized to, half away from zero (UW_PROTOCOL_v1.md §VIII.5). Omit to take the normative default for `unit` ($ = 2, % = 6, x = 4, otherwise 6). This is a precision contract that receipt digests depend on, not a display hint.

deterministic.description: MUST be true in v1. Reserved for v2 stochastic calcs.

validations.description: Cross-section consistency rules contributed by this module.

rule.description: Safe-expression returning boolean. true = passes; false = emits the message.

thresholds.description: Partial override of FinancialThresholds defaults. Only properties present are overridden.

view_models.description: Per-section view-model overrides. Replaces BUILTIN_VIEW_MODELS entries for matching section_id.

ui.description: Free-form host-specific UI hints. Hosts MAY ignore unrecognized keys.

agent_layers.description: Bancroft-style agent layer declarations contributed by this module.

prompt_template.description: Template body for the layer's system prompt. Placeholders use {{ section.field }} syntax resolved by the agent host.

depends_on.description: Other modules this one requires. The host MUST refuse to load if a dependency is missing or version-incompatible.

path.description: Dot-path within the section's content, resolved via parser.deepGet.
